verdict_text:
YES

The script drops every `h.2.*`, `h.5.*`, `h.8.*` tensor, maps surviving indices 0,1,3,4,6,7,9,10,11 to 0..8 in order into a fresh dict (so no overwrite collisions), passes the four non-block tensors through untouched, and asserts before writing that the block index set is exactly {0..8} (which also rules out any surviving 9/10/11) and that the total is 121 tensors. Assertion failure exits non-zero with nothing written, and the output lands at `out/T1/model.safetensors`. The only caveat is the unseen `_ckpt.load_checkpoint` helper, assumed to return the raw name-to-tensor dict from the safetensors file.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
